t: Ronseal Ultimate Protection Decking Stain in Stone Grey is a water-based solution designed for exterior wooden decking, offering comprehensive protection against weather damage, scuffs, scratches, and daily wear and tear. This hard-wearing, anti-slip stain is ideal for garden patios and outdoor living areas, enhancing safety and aesthetics. Its quick-drying formula is rainproof in just 90 minutes, allowing for efficient application with a brush or pad. A 2.5Ltr tin covers approximately 20 square metres, with recoating possible in four hours for a complete finish on timber surfaces.
